title: Emrys and the Extraction
author: Noor Nakamura
blurb: Edmund Hartwell, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
